articles.headline: Spantik Peak mission to retrieve body of Pakistani climber halted amid heavy snowfall
articles.summary: AI summary: A rescue team retreated from Camp 2 on Spantik Peak after heavy snowfall made conditions too dangerous, halting efforts to recover the body of Lahore-based physician Dr Asma Mushtaq, who died from altitude sickness while descending after summiting. Officials say the operation also faces logistical hurdles, including a lack of helicopter-evacuation insurance and Pakistan's absence of a dedicated high-altitude rescue system.
